name: Article 3, § 1, point 9 – 98
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on circularity requirements for vehicle design and on management of end-of-life vehicles, amending Regulations (EU) 2018/858 and 2019/1020 and repealing Directives 2000/53/EC and 2005/64/EC
part_text: (9) ‘plastic’ means a polymer within the meaning of Article 3, points (2) and (3), of Commission Regulation (EU) No 10/20111a, to which additives or other substances may have been added, capable of functioning as a main structural component of final materials and articles; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Commission Regulation (EU) No 10/2011 of 14 January 2011 on plastic materials and articles intended to come into contact with food (OJ L 12, 15.1.2011, p. 1, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2011/10/oj).
